title: 标注一致性两轮 Kappa：规范迭代前后
expected_output:
第1轮 kappa=0.000
第2轮 kappa=1.000
code:
r1_a = [1,0,1,1,0,1,0,0]
r1_b = [0,0,1,0,1,1,0,1]
r2_a = [1,0,1,1,0,1,0,0]
r2_b = [1,0,1,1,0,1,0,0]

def kappa(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    p = sum(1 for i in range(n) if x[i]==y[i]) / n
    pa = sum(x)/n
    pe = pa*pa + (1-pa)*(1-pa)
    return (p-pe)/(1-pe)

print(f"第1轮 kappa={kappa(r1_a, r1_b):.3f}")
print(f"第2轮 kappa={kappa(r2_a, r2_b):.3f}")
